import.balances.title: Check the balances
import.balances.intro: Type the balance your bank shows, so the app can check its own. This is optional, and the app adjusts nothing.

import.balances.dateAria: Date of the balance your bank shows for {account}

import.balances.problem.date: Choose the date of that balance.
import.balances.problem.future: The date can't be after today.
import.balance.differs: The balance differs by {difference}. Your bank shows {entered} and the app works out {calculated}.
import.balance.notCheckedNote: Until you type a balance, {account} counts as up to date by its dates, but nothing has checked it against your bank.
import.balance.flagged: The app flags this account for you to look at. It adjusts nothing, and you can still add the file.

import.updating: The app is updating the preview.
import.trouble.refused: The app stored nothing. {reason} You can try again or choose another file.
import.trouble.conflict: The facts changed while the app was adding the file, so it stored nothing. You can try again.
import.trouble.failed: Something went wrong inside the app, and it stored nothing. You can try again or choose another file.
import.trouble.unsure: The app can't tell whether it added the file. Look at the Imports tab before you try again.
import.trouble.planFailed: The app couldn't update the preview, so what you see may be out of date. Add waits until the preview updates.
import.trouble.outOfSync: The app added the file, but this window couldn't catch up with it. Refresh to see it.
import.note.choiceDropped: The app couldn't give line {line} the job you chose, so it let your choice go. Choose again if you want a job there.
import.refused.title.unreadable: The app can't open this file
import.refused.title.unrecognised: The app doesn't recognise this file
import.refused.title.unparseable: The app couldn't read this file
import.refused.title.blocked: The app won't import this file
import.refused.title.expired: The app no longer has this file
import.refused.unreadable.missing: The app can't find {fileName}. It may have been moved or deleted.
import.refused.unreadable.denied: The app isn't allowed to read {fileName}. Check who can open the file, then choose it again.
import.refused.unreadable.tooLarge: {fileName} is far bigger than a bank export, so the app won't read it. The limit is 32 MB.
import.refused.unreadable.notText: {fileName} isn't a text file. Choose a CSV or OFX export from your bank.
import.refused.unrecognised: The app doesn't recognise {fileName}. It reads CSV exports from Bulder and SpareBank 1 SR-Bank, and OFX files.
import.refused.unparseableLine: The app couldn't read line {line} of {fileName}.
import.refused.wrongCurrency: This file is in {file}. Your household uses {household}.
import.refused.duplicateFile: You already imported this file. Adding it again would repeat every row, so the app won't. To import it again, undo that import first.
import.refused.duplicateFileOn: You imported this file on {day}. Adding it again would repeat every row, so the app won't. To import it again, undo that import first.
import.refused.noKnownAccounts: {fileName} has no rows for accounts Holt knows. The app left out the accounts below. Add them first, then import the file again.
import.refused.badChoice: The app can't give line {line} the job you chose. Choose a different job, or leave it to the app.
import.refused.expired: The app holds only the last file you chose, and it no longer holds this one. Choose it again.
import.refused.failed: Something went wrong inside the app, and it stored nothing. Choose the file again.

import.undo.removes: {count, plural, =0 {This undo removes no transactions.} one {This undo removes # transaction.} other {This undo removes # transactions.}}
